Chapter 8 275 Lia came looking for me occasionally , but I just told her through closed doors that I wanted to be alone for a while .

She would sigh each time , set down some food on the ground , and leave . Lia wasn't the only one who came looking for me . " Iris ! Open up the door ! I know that you're in there ! " It was Liam's hoarse , furious voice . I curled up in a corner and covered my ears . I didn't want to hear him or even look at him . I wanted to pretend that I didn't care about him at all . "You fucking deleted me ? Blocked me ? " he roared , hammering loudly against the door . " All because I got into a fight with somebody else ? Come out and explain yourself !

" I didn't make a sound , but tears wouldn't stop falling from my eyes . Explain myself ? What was I supposed to explain ? Was I supposed to explain that I was like this because he got into a fight and then let Elena wear his shirt and treat his place like her home ? There was a brief silence outside the door . Liam's voice turned low and hoarse as he pleaded with me . " Iris , please ... Open the door ... We need to talk ... " I rushed over to the door and screamed at it . " Go away ! I don't Chapter 8 3/5 want to listen to you anymore !

Go and find that ' someone else 1 who can stand by your side when you need them ! Don't bother me anymore ! " He went absolutely quiet after that . After what felt like an eternity , I finally heard his footsteps leaving . I then slid to the floor and cried so hard that I could barely even catch my breath . When Lia found Liam , he was sitting next to the ice rink by himself , staring blankly at the ice . " You still had the nerve to go look for her ? " Lia snapped . Liam looked up . His eyes were dark , and his face was unshaven . " She won't see me . I can't call her .

She won't even open the door for me . I- " " You deserved it ! " Lia exclaimed , throwing a stack of documents at him . " Just look at these ! Look at all these ! " They were all screenshots of the post on the campus online forum , showing Elena and Liam being " intimate " at the ice rink . There were also screenshots of another post showing photos of him and Elena at the ball . " It was because of these ? " Liam asked with a frown . "Elena- " Chapter 8 " And these , too ! " Lia said , throwing out a few more screenshots of her conversation with me .

" Mom complained about the family business again today . She told me to find someone stable who's not like Dad , always on the edge of bankruptcy . " I know I'm not good enough for him . " He's destined to live a dazzling life under the lights , surrounded by flowers and applause . There's no room for me beside him , " my messages read . Liam kept flipping through the chat history , his face turning paler with each page . " She never told me , " he said , his voice trembling . " How was she supposed to tell you anything ? She's such a strong - willed , prideful , stubborn person !

" Lia's eyes were red now , too . " She saw your photos with Elena . She heard rumors about your arranged marriage . She also saw Elena inside your dorm ! What did you expect her to think ? " She thinks that she's a burden to you ! That she's nothing but trouble ! " Liam leaped to his feet . " Elena was returning something to my roommate that day ! That shirt belonged to my roommate ! Those photos only looked wrong because of the angle ! I don't Chapter 8 have any fucking thing to do with Elena ! " Liam gasped loudly , as if he had finally found a venting outlet .

" I got into a fight because those fuckers were talking shit about her ! They called her a pervert ! A stalker! I couldn't take it anymore ! " He then grabbed Lia's arm and said , " Where is she ? Bring me to see her ! I need to explain everything properly to her ! " Lia looked at his red - rimmed eyes and sighed . " I don't think she wants to see you now . " " Then make her say it to my face ! " Liam said , his voice hoarse . " I want her to look me in the eyes and tell me that she doesn't want me anymore ! " Chapter 9 1/6

chapters.title: Chapter 9
chapters.content:
Chapter 9 That afternoon , Elena was cornered by Liam outside the cheerleading practice room . The other cheerleaders who thought of approaching Liam to greet him were quickly intimidated by his glare . " The photos , the forum posts , and the day when you went to ' return some stuff ' to my roommate , " Liam said , his voice completely frigid . " Elena , take yourself and your filthy deeds and fuck off from my and Iris ' lives . " Elena was still trying to play dumb . She forced a smile at him and said , " What are you saying , Liam ? I- " " Stop pretending , " Liam said , interrupting her .

He took a step forward , his presence imposing , and said , " Do you dare to deny it ? " Elena paled . She stubbornly refused to back down , however , and said , " So what if it was me ? I was just exposing the truth for everyone to see ! Iris does not deserve to- " "It's not up to you to decide whether she deserves it or not , " Liam said , glaring at her . " This is my final warning to you , Elena . I have absolutely zero interest in you . The only person I have , and will ever love , is Iris Jepson . Do you understand me ? Chapter 9 " I dare you to lay another finger on her .

" Then , Liam turned and walked away without giving her a backward glance . I stayed up all night and welded the final piece of broken glass onto my artwork . Just as the sky was beginning to light up , I began packing up my things and prepared to head back to my dorm . I opened the studio door , letting in a cold gust of wind that swept some of the rain into the studio . Someone was standing at the door , completely drenched . His hair was plastered onto his forehead , and droplets of rain were still dripping down his chin .

The dark jacket he was wearing was soaked and had turned an even deeper shade , clinging tightly to his body . Liam - he was leaning against the wall . I didn't know how long he'd been waiting there for me . There were quite a few cigarette butts on the ground , and they were all already soaked up in the rain . He straightened up when he saw me coming out of the studio . I instinctively backed away , wanting to close the door . He immediately stepped forward and stopped the door from closing , bracing against it with great strength .

" We need to talk , " he said , his voice incredibly hoarse and Chapter 9 sounding damp and cold from the rain . " There's nothing to talk about , " I said , looking away from him . I didn't want to see how disheveled he was . " There is , " he said , still bracing against the door as water droplets slid down his face . " We must talk . " He then shoved harder against the door , pushing it open a little wider , and squeezed in through the gap sideways . " Everything Elena said was a lie , " he started . " The photos were captured at a weird angle .

And she purposely came to my apartment and splashed water all over herself . " That shirt she wore belonged to my roommate . Everything was a show she put on for you . I have absolutely nothing going on with her . " I lowered my head and looked at the puddles of water on the floor without saying a word . " I've already contacted the moderator to delete the posts on the online forum . We found the original poster's IP address . It's Elena's second account . I will also deal with all the people who insulted you and called you names . " I still refused to lift my head .

" I got into a fight because they were talking shit about you . I couldn't hold back any longer . " Liam then lowered his voice and said , " I got suspended for three matches , but I never Chapter 9 regretted it . " He then reached out , wanting to touch my face , but I avoided him . Liam's hand froze mid - air . Then , he slowly lowered it with much hesitation . " Iris . " Liam's voice began trembling . It sounded like he was about to start sobbing soon . " You deleted my contact , you blocked me , and you refused to see me . Do you know what it's done to me over the past few days ?

" he continued . I bit my lip and felt my nose tingling . " I nearly went crazy without you ! " Liam suddenly exclaimed , his voice louder than usual . However , he quickly suppressed his volume again , as if he was afraid that he would scare me away . " I thought that you really didn't want me anymore ... " Liam took a deep breath , the raindrops falling off his long eyelashes . " Yes . It's true that my dad wants me to find someone of equal status , but that's not what I want ! " Liam took a step forward , closing in on me . " The person I've always wanted is you !

You're the only one I want ! I already knew that you were the one for me when you Chapter 9 put that stupid band - aid on my face and blew on the cut to make it better ! " Liam then gripped my shoulders and asked , " Why didn't you tell me about your family situation ? Why did you have to bear everything by yourself ? Did you really think that I would care that you came from a family like that ? " His eyes reddened , and his voice went completely hoarse as he sobbed , " You're the one I'm the most worried and concerned about ! Your dad's business doesn't matter !

" Tears began falling from my eyes . I struggled to break free from him . " Let me go ... " " I'm not letting go ! " Liam roared , forcefully pulling me into his arms . His wet clothes pressed against me . However , his chest was hot and burning , and I could also feel how quickly his heart was thumping against his chest . " I'm sorry . I was wrong , " he said , his voice muffled as he buried his face in the crook of my neck . " I should have realized earlier that you were avoiding me because of all these . I never should have given Elena a chance to hurt you ...

Liam hugged me so tightly that even my bones began to creak. I couldn't run away from him anymore . I didn't want to run Chapter 9 away from him anymore , either . " Iris ... " He lifted his head and cradled my face with his hands , forcing me to look at him . " Look at me . Please give me a chance , " he said , wiping away my tears with his rough , calloused thumbs . " Let me prove to you that I will never let you go , no matter what happens . " Chapter 10

chapters.title: Chapter 10
chapters.content:
Chapter 10 Liam then led me to a warehouse outside campus . With his hand gently placed over my eyes , he said , " Close your eyes . " A faint dusty , musky smell of dust and paint then filled the air . " Okay . You can open your eyes now . " The warehouse was filled with all sorts of items . There was no main source of light inside ; only a few spotlights hung from the ceiling , shining in the middle of the space . I went to the first shelf and saw that it was lined with velvet . There was an ugly stone with a smiley face drawn on it.

It was the stone I had given him when we were in middle school . I told him that he was like a rock - hard and annoying . The second shelf housed a crumpled - up piece of a candy wrapper . It was orange - flavored . I suffered from low blood sugar , and Liam could only find this candy after going to all the convenience stores he could find . I thought the candy was too sour for me , so I only ate one . The third shelf contained a thick stack of train tickets from my village home to this city .

He would always come looking for me during the summer and winter holidays , or maybe I would go home at the same time . The edges of each train ticket were worn down . Chapter 10 The fourth shelf held a lot of photos . Most of the photos were secretly taken , and they were all of me . One showed me yawning at the library . Another showed me running on the tracks at school , and another showed me feeding the stray cats after class. The photo angles were mostly crooked , but I was always smiling happily in these photos . The fifth shelf contained an old gray scarf .

He had given it to me one winter , telling me I would catch a cold if I went out with my neck bare . After wearing it a couple of times , I lost it and couldn't find it again . Finally , the last shelf was locked . He took out the keys and unlocked it to show me the things inside . They were all my things - the sketching pencil that I thought I'd lost , some drafts that I'd crumpled up then smoothed out again , like those of him I drew while he played ice hockey- and my missing brown sketchbook . I took the sketchbook and flipped through the pages .

Every sketch I'd made of him was still inside . " Elena secretly took those photos when I wasn't paying attention , " he said . " I accidentally put it in my bag last time . Then , when I found out what was in the sketchbook ... " Liam's voice went lower . " I just ... Wanted to hold on to it . " Chapter 10 I feathered the scribbled lines on the sketchbook and couldn't find the words to say . " I'm also afraid of things , Iris , " Liam said , leaning against one of the shelves .

"I was afraid that you would think I was only a jock who knew how to play ice hockey , and was boring and simple - minded . I was afraid that you would become a famous artist and look down on me afterward . " I was afraid that you would fly too high and too far away from me until I couldn't catch you anymore . All that talk about finding someone of equal status with me can go to hell . " Liam turned around and looked me straight in the eye , his eyes burning with passion . Then , he walked over and stopped in front of me before he asked , " Do you believe me now?

" My vision began blurring with tears . I nodded again and again . Liam smiled . He leaned down and kissed my tears away before pressing his lips against mine . He was no longer as aggressive and demanding as before . The kiss was slow , sweet , and gentle , as if he were savoring the taste of my lips and confirming my feelings for him. It was very quiet inside the warehouse , with only the sounds of our breathing . Liam picked me up and gently set me on an old couch , a thick blanket thrown over it . The warm yellow light from the Chapter 10 spotlight fell on us . " May I ?

" he asked in a hoarse voice . I reached up and hooked my arms around his neck , showing him my answer instead . He kissed me , deeper than before , yet still as gentle as ever . His hands then slipped inside my shirt , his calloused palms warm and hot , brushing against my sides and making me break out in goosebumps everywhere . I couldn't stop myself from moaning out loud . Liam chuckled against my ear , his hot breath fanning against the shell of my ear . " We can go slow this time . " Our bodies intertwined as the couch creaked slightly in protest .

Sweat clung to our skin , and the air was thick with the scent of our lovemaking . This time , there were no misunderstandings , no alcohol , and no attitude involved - just a clear , unspoken desire and certainty between both of us . When it was all over , I sprawled out over his body , completely spent , but feeling more at peace with myself than I'd ever felt before . I instinctively traced the lines on his sweaty skin with my fingers , feeling something strange beneath my fingers . I sat up and took a closer look under the spotlights .

There , right Chapter 10 beneath his shoulder blade , close to his heart , was a new tattoo . 5/5 It was the first initial of my name and his , an " I " and an " L " nestled against each other , right next to a sculpting knife and a hockey stick that were crossed together . Chapter 11 1/2

chapters.title: Chapter 11
chapters.content:
Chapter 11 It was the last ten seconds of the final match . The hockey puck went right into the goal , and the entire stadium erupted in wild cheering . Liam was tossed into the air by his teammates as the cheer continued , blowing the roof off the stadium . I had been sitting in a corner of the stands and tried sneaking away when a spotlight suddenly shone on me . " Excuse me , miss . Please stay where you are . " I froze at once and couldn't open my eyes . Liam then pushed through the crowd , got off the ice rink , and started walking toward me .

He was drenched in sweat , and he didn't even bother taking off his protective gear , still clutching the victory bouquet in his hands when he stopped in front of me . He was panting softly , and his eyes were shining ever so brightly, too . The entire stadium quietened down , and all the cameras were pointed at us . " Iris , " he said , his voice reverberating through the whole stadium as he spoke into a mic . " These flowers , this person , and this victory are all yours . " Then , he held my face in his hands and kissed me in front of everyone else .

His protective gear got in the way , but his lips Chapter 11 were boiling against mine . At once , loud claps and cheers erupted in the stadium , 2/2 accompanied by some loud whistles as well , nearly setting the roof on fire . I could hear everyone exclaiming in shock while camera shutters went off like crazy . Liam finally released me and pressed his forehead against mine . " Now , the whole world knows that you're mine .

" A few years later , in our own apartment , our daughter , Angela Blake , giggled loudly as she rode on Liam's shoulders , reaching for the hanging bell ornaments on the Christmas tree . Meanwhile , our son , Noel Blake , sat on the ground while clumsily kneading a lump of Play - Doh , vowing to make the coolest reindeer to hang on the tree . I finished decorating the last Christmas wreath with some mistletoe and smiled as I watched them play . Liam soon set Angela down and walked over to me. He hugged me from the back and nestled his chin against the crook of my neck . " See that ?

" he asked with a smile in his voice . " I told you that no matter what , I would never let go of your hand . "
